summary: Pre-market: the composite eased -0.15 to 44.02 (caution, goldilocks) even as the macro block, still the heaviest at 61.5, keeps rates heavy. The 10Y finished 4.78 (+0.01), the 2Y 4.37 (+0.03) and the 10Y real rate 2.43 (+0.01); FedWatch still prices 3.945 — a hike — against an effective rate of 3.63. Overnight the US-Iran shipping standoff escalated, with Iran vowing a firm response to any US military attack, and the inflation impulse is starting to show in breakevens: 5Y5Y 2.34 (+0.01), 10Y 2.37 (+0.02). Yet VIX 15.3 (+0.77) and HY OAS flat at 2.68 still refuse to confirm stress. The AI tape rotated: AMD +5.9, AVGO +2.98 and TSLA +3.98 led, while NVDA -2.01 and MU -1.61 lagged; AI software -2.29 and fintech -2.48 were offered against data centers +2.74 and semiconductor equipment +2.81. The CN AI panel closed lower (688825.SH -2.6, 300475.SZ -2.86, 301308.SZ -3.02), and Meta trades +4% pre-market on the Muse agent launch. Watch US PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11.

top_risk_drivers.claim: The macro block is the heaviest at 61.5 with a falling trend: the 10Y at 4.78 (+0.01), the 2Y at 4.37 (+0.03) and the 10Y real rate at 2.43 (+0.01) keep rates restrictive, and FedWatch still prices 3.945 — a hike — against an effective rate of 3.63.
The US-Iran shipping standoff escalated overnight, and the energy-driven inflation impulse is showing up in breakevens: 5Y5Y at 2.34 (+0.01) and 10Y at 2.37 (+0.02), while headline risk still fell.
Cross-asset confirmation sits at 0.5 — signals disagree across assets, keeping the composite's directional read unstable at 44.02.
Liquidity keeps draining: reverse repo fell to 0.626 and reserve balances to 2894531, with the Treasury general account at 967935.

supporting_signals.claim: Volatility stays subdued despite the geopolitical noise: VIX 15.3 (+0.77) and realized vol 8.3223 leave the volatility block at 18.1.
Credit refuses to confirm stress: HY OAS flat at 2.68 and IG OAS flat at 0.81 through the escalation.
The trend block is rising: price sits 7.4757 above the MA200 with 3m momentum 3.6173 and a shallow 52w drawdown of -1.5324.

contradicting_signals.claim: Front-end rates moved with the energy shock while vol and credit did not: the 2Y rose to 4.37 (+0.03) even as VIX 15.3 and HY OAS 2.68 stayed calm — the macro read and the risk tape disagree.
The CN AI panel closed broadly lower against the US hardware rebound: 688825.SH -2.6, 300475.SZ -2.86, 301308.SZ -3.02, with only 600584.SH +0.06 and 002156.SZ +0.05 up.
Breadth is split: new highs 0.0129 equal new lows 0.0129 on MA200 breadth of 0.6129, and semis relative strength sits at -11.1508.

Rates: 10Y 4.77 to 4.78, 2Y 4.34 to 4.37, real rate 2.42 to 2.43; dollar index eased to 118.0732.
VIX 14.53 to 15.3 (+0.77); breakevens firmed with 5Y5Y 2.33 to 2.34 and 10Y 2.35 to 2.37.
Sector rotation: autos +3.98, semiconductor equipment +2.81, data centers +2.74, networking +2.65 vs AI software -2.29 and fintech -2.48.
AI leaders: AMD +5.9 and AVGO +2.98 vs NVDA -2.01 and MU -1.61; TSLA +3.98 tracked autos.
Meta +4% pre-market on the Muse personal AI agent; reverse repo fell to 0.626 from 0.675.
watch_next: US PPI on 2026-09-10 and CPI on 2026-09-11 — the vote on whether FedWatch's 3.945 hike pricing survives.
ADBE earnings on 2026-09-10 (forecast 6.08) and FDX on 2026-09-17 (forecast 4.21).
US retail sales on 2026-09-16 for the consumer read.
Whether breakevens (5Y5Y 2.34, 10Y 2.37) keep climbing while HY OAS stays 2.68 — that divergence decides the composite's next move.
Breadth: with new highs 0.0129 equal to new lows 0.0129, watch which side breaks first.

bull_case.title: Energy impulse fades, credit stays anchored
points: HY OAS holds at 2.68 and IG at 0.81 while VIX 15.3 and realized vol 8.3223 stay near cycle lows.
Trend stays constructive: price 7.4757 above MA200, momentum 3.6173, drawdown -1.5324, with the composite easing at 44.02.

base_case.title: Steady caution into PPI and CPI
points: The composite drifts near 44.02 with the macro block heavy at 61.5 and cross-asset confirmation stuck at 0.5.
Rates grind: 10Y 4.78, 2Y 4.37, real rate 2.43 against FedWatch 3.945 until the inflation prints land.

bear_case.title: Oil-led inflation impulse broadens
points: Breakevens 5Y5Y 2.34 and 10Y 2.37 keep climbing and pull the 2Y beyond 4.37, pushing FedWatch past 3.945.
Breadth rolls over from 0.6129 with new lows 0.0129 catching up, and semis relative strength -11.1508 deepens.
